ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives. Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, May 4, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m and to French Commercial students on Monday, May 11, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or French Commercial Studies or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship major(s) or minor(s).
